_comment: The versioned method the deterministic engine runs under. Every analysis
is stamped with the version it used, so a figure can always be traced to
the rules in force when it was produced. A change to market practice is a
NEW version with its own effective date and source - never an edit to an
existing one. Treaty terms are not here: they come from the treaty book
and the wordings. This file holds only conventions that apply across
treaties when a wording is silent, and the damage model's parameters.

reinstatement_premium.rule: pro rata as to amount, per occurrence, on the limit eroded by that occurrence while reinstatement capacity remains

reinstatement_capacity.rule: aggregate cover = limit x (1 + number of reinstatements); erosion past capacity pays nothing further and earns no reinstatement premium

occurrence_retention.rule: the retention applies afresh to each loss occurrence as defined by the treaty's hours clause

replay_basis.rule: a historical event is replayed as-if on the current book; the treaty-period test applies only when as_if is false

money.rule: decimal arithmetic, half-up rounding, amounts in millions of treaty currency

changelog.change: Initial method: Emanuel (2011) wind curve with Eberenz (2021) v_half, illustrative MMI table, pro-rata-as-to-amount reinstatement premium.
